label: Read connector and resource context
field_scope: Site or resource context; application inventory; schemas; deployment mode
qualification_limits: Installed tools or applications do not establish resource access or method scopes.

label: Read authoritative operation contracts
field_scope: Versioned method schemas; limitations; publication and effective dates
qualification_limits: Current primary documentation must be retrieved during adapter qualification; this reconciliation performs no current contract verification.

label: Read permitted source evidence
field_scope: Public documents; decisions; source records; reports; revisions
candidate_adapter_families: Official sources; document store; permitted exports
qualification_limits: Record retrieval time and revision; historical evidence is not current access evidence.

label: Write versioned evidence and proposals
field_scope: Minimized evidence; provenance; hashes; observations; proposals
qualification_limits: No replacement task ledger; no private credentials or tenant identifiers in public artifacts.

label: Read authoritative task state
field_scope: Tasks; supported events; state; revocation
qualification_limits: Read the authoritative mechanism; an interactive connector does not establish unattended execution.

label: Read scope and routing contracts
field_scope: Scope; routing; permissions; core contracts
qualification_limits: Do not infer queue authority or replace the existing access-control model.

label: Read authoritative leases
field_scope: Resource claims; lease identity; expiry; revocation
qualification_limits: Historical lease observations are not valid current leases.

label: Invoke the existing task protocol
field_scope: Task transitions; leases; routing events as authorized
qualification_limits: Only the existing canonical mechanism; no parallel queue, ACL or scheduler authority; exact transition receipt required.

label: Configure one authorized schedule
field_scope: Schedule; timezone; event trigger; retry and alert policy
qualification_limits: Qualify renewable credentials, costs, DST, idempotency and revocation; avoid duplicate routines.

label: Read source and CI evidence
field_scope: Files; revisions; diffs; tests; builds; releases
qualification_limits: Bind exact repository, checkout and revision; local builds do not prove platform or live deployment.

label: Prepare a source change candidate
field_scope: Diff; branch; draft change or pull request; validation evidence
qualification_limits: Use the existing change path and concurrency controls; proposal does not authorize publication.

label: Publish through the authoritative release flow
field_scope: Accepted release; deployed revision; rollback reference
candidate_adapter_families: Existing CMS or repository release workflow
qualification_limits: No alternative publisher; verify platform build and live result; do not overwrite newer revisions.

label: Derive audit candidate results
field_scope: Findings; evidence references; candidate patches; evaluation results
qualification_limits: Source declares historical local fixtures only; no new core implementation or live host binding is evidenced here.

label: Derive minimized reports and exports
field_scope: Normalized aggregates; report provenance; limitations
qualification_limits: Reuse a suitable existing consumer; no public dashboard or paid connector is implied.

label: Read site metadata and inheritance
field_scope: Site-wide metadata; inherited tags
qualification_limits: Resolve inheritance and existing unknown tags before proposing changes.

label: Write site metadata
field_scope: Exact site-wide metadata fields
qualification_limits: Global impact and replacement semantics require immediate read, merge, diff and exact method qualification.

label: Read metadata patterns
field_scope: Pattern type; variables; defaults; overrides
qualification_limits: Do not invent variables; identify default versus override ownership.

label: Write an exact metadata pattern
field_scope: Accepted pattern fields for one defined family
qualification_limits: Qualify whole-object replacement, conflicts, scope and backup before mutation.

label: Read exact item metadata
field_scope: Item identity; SEO tags; locale; inheritance
qualification_limits: Use actual item IDs and primary or secondary locale contracts separately.

label: Write exact item metadata
field_scope: Accepted metadata fields for exact item IDs
qualification_limits: No compare-and-swap assumed; serialize, re-read, preserve unknown fields, detect drift and verify resulting HTML.

label: Read resolved metadata
field_scope: Resolved tags by URL; metadata inheritance; locale; cache evidence
qualification_limits: Local development is insufficient; verify published SSR and documented locale or main-page limitations.

label: Read authoritative route registry
field_scope: Registered routes; public page registry; route owner
qualification_limits: Compare with head and generated sitemap; a provider sitemap-list method may omit route classes.

label: Publish routes through the existing registry flow
field_scope: Accepted route registration; build or publication inputs
qualification_limits: No competing registry, sitemap generator or reserved-route writer.

label: Read public sitemap documents
field_scope: Sitemap index; child sitemap URLs; route coverage
qualification_limits: Sitemap presence and submission are distinct from crawling and indexing.

label: Read redirect rules
field_scope: Complete redirect graph; exact rule IDs; locale and options
qualification_limits: Inspect the full graph and current provider mutation semantics.

label: Create an exact redirect rule
field_scope: Accepted source; destination; options; locale
qualification_limits: Exact mandate and rollback needed; provider side effects may alter chained rules.

label: Delete an exact redirect rule
field_scope: Exact accepted redirect rule IDs
qualification_limits: Reconcile current graph before delete; do not invent an update method.

label: Apply qualified bulk redirect operations
field_scope: Accepted rule batch; item-level results
qualification_limits: Qualify operation support, partial results, idempotency and rollback; no mutated retry after an uncertain result.

label: Read public service catalog
field_scope: Service IDs; prices; currency; publication; public providers; calendar binding
qualification_limits: Provider IDs and service IDs differ; no private bookings, customers or commercial decisions are included.

label: Read necessary public availability
field_scope: Public availability and exact service-to-calendar destination
qualification_limits: Qualify page, service and locale binding; use the minimum public data needed; no reservation writes.

label: Test direct calendar navigation
field_scope: CTA target; keyboard path; locale; empty and signed-out states
qualification_limits: No slot hold, booking, payment or notification; test the published one-click destination.

label: Read accepted localization coverage
field_scope: Locales; field translations; acceptance; source hashes; hreflang
qualification_limits: Menu language is not reviewed coverage; metadata locale support must be qualified independently.

label: Publish accepted localized content
field_scope: Accepted translated fields; locale publication state
qualification_limits: Qualified editorial authority owns publication; do not withdraw languages merely because evidence is incomplete.

label: Inspect bounded public HTTP resources
field_scope: Status; headers; HTML head; robots; links; redirects; assets
qualification_limits: Allowlisted origins and redirects, byte/time/depth limits and SSRF checks; timeout is unknown, not failure or zero.

label: Map or crawl permitted public content
field_scope: Map; raw HTML; extracted text; links; coverage and freshness
qualification_limits: Reuse a qualified existing crawler; cleaned markdown is not head evidence; tool success is not target HTTP status.

label: Read permitted public web search results
field_scope: Search query; returned public results; source URLs; retrieval context
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified Firecrawl search or other permitted public search adapter
qualification_limits: Source-declared search capability only; qualify exact current interface, scope, result coverage, costs and freshness; no private data access.

label: Configure an authorized content monitor
field_scope: Monitor target; cadence; scope; retention and alert policy
qualification_limits: Source proposes recurring monitoring only under an authorized implementation; costs, quotas and retention require qualification.

label: Read published rendered evidence
field_scope: Rendered DOM; SSR differences; mobile and locale state
qualification_limits: Prefer sufficient provider connector; qualify target, environment and permitted session; exclude private screenshots.

label: Test permitted nontransactional interactions
field_scope: Keyboard behavior; mobile navigation; interface-only evidence
qualification_limits: No transactional actions, forced bypass or unsupported session assumptions; browser fallback must be allowed.

label: Read search performance aggregates
field_scope: Query; page; country; device; date; impressions; clicks; reported position
candidate_adapter_families: GSC Search Analytics; Bing qualified search API or export
qualification_limits: Bind property, readonly scope, interval, filters, data state, pagination, withheld rows, completeness and watermark; do not assume an AI search type.

label: Read provider indexed-state evidence
field_scope: Indexed version; canonical; last crawl; index evidence
candidate_adapter_families: GSC URL Inspection; qualified Bing index evidence
qualification_limits: The GSC indexed-state API is neither a live test nor an indexing request; select URLs and qualify current quotas.

label: Read search-provider sitemap status
field_scope: Submitted sitemap identities; processing status; dates
candidate_adapter_families: GSC sitemap API; qualified Bing methods or export
qualification_limits: Qualify each actual method; processed or submitted does not mean crawled or indexed.

label: Submit an accepted sitemap
field_scope: Exact accepted sitemap location for a bound property
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified official search sitemap submission adapter
qualification_limits: Require correct property, sitemap and existing publisher; submission provides no crawl guarantee.

label: Read manual-action report
field_scope: Provider manual-action status and report evidence
qualification_limits: No API is asserted by this mapping; use an allowed UI/export route only when the report is available.

label: Read search-provider security report
field_scope: Provider security report evidence
qualification_limits: No API is asserted; qualify available official report and preserve unknown versus unavailable.

label: Read generative-search report
field_scope: Available impressions and supported page, country, device and date dimensions
candidate_adapter_families: GSC official generative-AI report UI or export
qualification_limits: API unconfirmed in source; do not invent clicks, positions or exact prompts; overlapping Web totals must not be added together.

label: Read generative-search inclusion control
field_scope: Actual current inclusion or opt-out setting and scope
qualification_limits: Control is separate from reporting; current availability and effect require exact product qualification.

label: Change an exact generative-search inclusion control
field_scope: Accepted inclusion control for an exact bound resource
qualification_limits: Excluded from default report reading; no API is invented; require explicit authorized control scope and rollback evidence.

label: Read search-provider backlink evidence
field_scope: Reported incoming links and completeness
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified Bing current REST method or export
qualification_limits: Qualify exact method, identity, pagination and current contract; do not assume legacy protocol support.

label: Read provider keyword evidence
field_scope: Reported keyword evidence and applicable dates
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified Bing current REST method or export
qualification_limits: Qualify current method, semantics, quotas and completeness; no fabricated volume.

label: Read provider crawl-health evidence
field_scope: Reported crawl, index and site-health diagnostics
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified Bing current REST or official export
qualification_limits: API coverage is method-specific; do not assume all UI reports have an API.

label: Submit supported URL notifications to a search provider
field_scope: Exact accepted URLs and submission receipt
qualification_limits: Separate from IndexNow and sitemap submission; do not infer a GSC URL Inspection submission capability.

label: Read answer-engine webmaster performance report
field_scope: Available citations; pages; grounding samples; topics; intents; share
candidate_adapter_families: Bing AI Performance official report or permitted export
qualification_limits: Dedicated API unconfirmed; preview and taxonomy vary; citation share is neither traffic nor rank; samples are incomplete.

label: Read index-notification receipt evidence
field_scope: Submission receipt; response; retry and acceptance status
qualification_limits: Receipt is acceptance by the protocol endpoint, not proof of indexing or search-engine participation.

label: Notify material canonical URL changes
field_scope: Added, changed or removed canonical URLs; verified host key
qualification_limits: Qualify host proof, batch limits, deduplication and retry contract; do not create a second emitter or infer Google participation.

label: Read field performance evidence
field_scope: Field CWV; device; period; URL or origin aggregation
qualification_limits: Missing field data is not zero; keep origin and URL evidence separate and qualify current quotas.

label: Run bounded laboratory diagnostics
field_scope: Lab performance; environment; run conditions; diagnostics
qualification_limits: Laboratory evidence is not field experience; noninteractive runs do not establish interaction metrics.

label: Read cache and delivery evidence
field_scope: Cache state; delivery headers; host configuration evidence
qualification_limits: Plugin availability does not establish site infrastructure or managed-platform control.

label: Read minimized infrastructure logs
field_scope: Aggregate statuses; errors; verified bot activity; blocking evidence
qualification_limits: Bind actual resource and readonly scopes; verify bot identity and redact identifiers.

label: Read relevant delivery and security rules
field_scope: Exact cache or security rule and affected scope
qualification_limits: No assumed resource permissions or global bypass capability.

label: Apply a minimal accepted infrastructure rule
field_scope: Exact accepted rule delta for one scoped resource
candidate_adapter_families: Actual qualified CDN; WAF; host adapter
qualification_limits: Require exact authority, impact and rollback; never disable security globally for an observation gap.

label: Read approved acquisition aggregates
field_scope: Approved acquisition events; sessions; source and entry aggregates
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified first-party analytics; GA4; approved export
qualification_limits: Keep analytics disabled where declared disabled; purpose, consent, dimensions and retention precede access; no sensitive URLs or identifiers.

label: Read approved funnel aggregates
field_scope: Approved minimized funnel and deduplicated event aggregates
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified existing analytics emitter or export
qualification_limits: No new emitter is implied; sensitive service interest may require dimension exclusion; unavailable is not zero.

label: Change approved analytics instrumentation
field_scope: Accepted instrumentation fields and deduplication configuration
qualification_limits: Conditional on purpose, consent, surface, retention and existing emitters; do not activate tracking merely for SEO measurement.

label: Read applicable consent configuration
field_scope: Purpose; consent state or policy; approved dimensions and retention
candidate_adapter_families: Approved consent configuration and policy source
qualification_limits: Configuration review does not permit individual consent records or expand analytics access.

label: Read approved conversion and finance aggregates
field_scope: Confirmed; paid; cancelled; refunded; net value with interval and currency
candidate_adapter_families: Approved minimized bookings or finance aggregate export
qualification_limits: Distinct from analytics events and service catalog; aggregate contract is undecided; exclude clinical, person, booking and payment identifiers and all action scopes.

label: Read licensed SERP observations
field_scope: Fixed query; location; language; device; depth; organic position and features
candidate_adapter_families: Permitted SERP supplier; manual cohort observation
qualification_limits: No supplier subscription assumed; define counting and context; API observations are not exact consumer SERPs or mean search-console position.

label: Read raw answer-surface search results
field_scope: Raw supported search results; sources; interface and context
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified current search APIs; permitted UI
qualification_limits: Bind provider, exact interface, version, cost and cohort; raw search and generated answer are different observations; no paid API activated.

label: Sample generated answers and citations
field_scope: Answer; citations; mentions; recommendations; cohort and run context
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified OpenAI; Anthropic; Perplexity; xAI or permitted consumer UI
qualification_limits: API and consumer UI require separate bindings and cohorts; do not infer consumer placement, reproducibility or exact prompts from API responses.

label: Read relevant public social search
field_scope: Relevant public posts; search context; provenance
qualification_limits: Separate X search from xAI generated answers, credentials, pricing and ranking; no direct messages or follower graphs.

label: Request an authorized external review
field_scope: Minimum sanitized review packet; model/interface; budget; returned report
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified external model or reviewer interface
qualification_limits: Confirm real provider, model, retention, cost and independence; a logical role or another API does not establish product-web review authorship.

label: Read public profiles and eligibility
field_scope: Public entity facts; credentials; contact; listing policy and eligibility
candidate_adapter_families: Official profile tools; directories; public pages
qualification_limits: Eligibility is provider-specific; source says online-only businesses cannot assume local-profile eligibility; do not invent addresses or reviews.

label: Publish accepted profile changes
field_scope: Accepted truthful listing fields for eligible entities
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified official profile or listing interface
qualification_limits: Exact publication mandate and verified eligibility required; listing does not buy ranking.

label: Send explicitly authorized external outreach
field_scope: Accepted recipient; channel; message; opportunity context
qualification_limits: Separate sending mandate required; no automatic contact, spam, review fabrication or link purchase.

label: Read eligible product feed evidence
field_scope: SKU; variants; price; stock; policies; channel eligibility
candidate_adapter_families: Qualified merchant catalog or channel feed
qualification_limits: Conditional product, category and territory eligibility; a clinical service is not automatically a product; not a pilot dependency.

label: Publish an accepted eligible merchant feed
field_scope: Accepted eligible product feed and channel validation results
qualification_limits: Conditional on eligibility and exact publication mandate; do not create a service feed by misclassification.
